member.returns: ResetToken with opaque handle (safe to send via email/SMS).

member.name: M:Sentinel.Application.Auth.Interfaces.IResetTokenProvider.ValidateAndConsumeAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Validates the opaque handle and returns a discriminated result. Implementation MUST enforce single-use semantics (consume on validation). Provides type-safe, extensible failure reasons instead of fragile tuples.
member.param: Opaque token handle from user input.
member.returns: Discriminated TokenValidationResult: - Success(email): Token valid, unexpired, unconsumed - Expired: Token past ExpiresAtUtc - AlreadyConsumed: Single-use token already used - NotFound: Handle not found or tampered - ValidationFailed: Storage/processing error
